threads.body: [Testing] New tests should not add AssertJ `.as(...)` descriptions; the direct assertion already reports the unexpected matching log lines. Please remove this description per the repository's Java test rules.

`.github/agents/knowledge/metadata-yaml-format.md` documents the same schema fields and still lists only `type`, `description`, and `default`, and neither of its two `declarative_schema` samples sets `example`.

The knowledge index marks that article mandatory for metadata review, so anyone following it keeps writing properties without `example`, and the generated file falls back to `<property-name>` placeholders.
